source.name: Source
source.description: The markdown source string to render.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Typing animation speed in milliseconds per character. 0 disables animation.

withBorder.name: With Border
withBorder.description: When true, wraps the viewer in a bordered container.

showLineNumbers.description: When true, shows line numbers in code blocks.

muted.name: Muted
muted.description: Use muted text color (text-cn-3) for markdown content.

variant.name: Variant
variant.description: Controls the visual size variant of the markdown viewer.
